title: After update to 3.0.0.1 xdrip displays wrong IOB
symptom: After updating to AndroidAPS 3.0.0.1, xDrip shows incorrect IOB values, whereas before it was usually close to what was shown in 2.8.2. The IOB shown in 3.0.0.1 seems accurate, and the same wrong IOB appears in xDrip on a second phone (Nightscout Follower) but not in NSClient.
